name: Secrets
description: Concealment, Confidence, The Thing Nobody Is Supposed To Know. A secret is not a lie — it is true, and hidden, and that combination has weight. Secrets is the Cognition of what is kept: it hides people and facts and whole buildings, it takes knowledge out of a mind and holds it, and it trades. Its wielders always know more than they should, which is a useful reputation and a dangerous one.

minor.name: Tongue-tied
minor.card: can't speak, or cast with verbal components

major.name: Blanked
major.card: it has forgotten one ability, and which one

severe.name: Kept
severe.card: Incapacitated — something of its own is missing

control.name: Taken
control.description: You take something out of their head and hold it. They feel the shape of the gap.

tiers.text: A creature that fails forgets one thing of your choice until the end of its next turn: a name, a face, a password, or the last thing it was told.
tiers.card: Fail: it forgets one thing you name until the end of its next turn

tiers.text: A creature that fails instead forgets one ability, spell or feature it knows for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. It knows something is missing.
tiers.card: 1 min: one ability, spell or feature forgotten (Int save each turn) — and it knows

conditions.name: Blanked
conditions.escape: Intelligence save at the end of each of its turns

tiers.text: What you take, you hold: for as long as the effect lasts you know the taken thing perfectly, and if it was a spell or an ability of the slot level or lower, you may use it once.
tiers.card: You hold what you took — and may use it once, if it was a spell or ability (≤ slot)

tiers.text: Kept. A creature that fails loses one thing it knows until you give it back, or until a Wish or a god intervenes: a name, a skill, a face, a decade, the location of something it hid. You may keep as many as you have hands for.
tiers.card: KEPT — it loses something known until you return it · you may hold several at once

control.name: Unspoken
control.description: The room agrees not to give anything away, and it means it.

tiers.text: For 1 minute, nothing inside the area can be heard, scried, read or remembered from outside it. Creatures that fail can't speak of what happens inside once they leave.
tiers.card: 1 min: nothing heard, scried or remembered from outside · those who fail can't tell

tiers.text: Creatures that failed can't communicate with anyone outside the area at all — no message, no signal, no telepathy, no spell.
tiers.card: No messages, signals or telepathy out, for those who failed

tiers.text: The area itself goes unnoticed: creatures outside see nothing remarkable where it is, and will not investigate it unless given a reason that does not come from within.
tiers.card: From outside, there is nothing here worth looking at

tiers.text: Nothing Leaves. For 10 minutes, no information crosses the boundary in either direction: no divination reaches in, no memory of it survives outside, and any creature that failed and later tries to reveal what happened finds it simply will not come out of its mouth.
tiers.card: NOTHING LEAVES — 10 min: no divination in, no memory out, and they physically cannot tell it

offensive.name: What You Are Hiding
offensive.description: You say it out loud. Only they hear it, and that is enough.

tiers.text: The damage becomes psychic as you name something it has kept. A creature hit or that fails can't speak, or cast with verbal components, until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Psychic · no speech or verbal components until their next turn

tiers.text: Against a creature concealing something significant — an identity, a betrayal, a hidden master — the seal deals 2 additional dice, and you learn the outline of what it is.
tiers.card: +2 dice against anyone hiding something real — and you learn its shape

tiers.text: A creature that fails blurts its secret aloud to everyone within 30 feet, in whatever language they speak.
tiers.card: They say it out loud, to everyone within 30 ft

tiers.text: Everything Comes Out. Every creature within 30 feet that failed reveals the thing it most wants concealed — plainly, in front of whoever is standing there — and can't lie about it for 1 minute.
tiers.card: EVERYTHING COMES OUT — each of them says the thing they least wanted said, and can't take it back

supportive.name: Kept Safe
supportive.description: Nobody can find them, and nobody can get anything out of them.

tiers.text: For 1 hour the target can't be found by divination or scrying, and its surface thoughts can't be read.
tiers.card: 1 hr: no divination, no scrying, no reading its thoughts

tiers.text: It may place one fact, memory or password in your keeping: nothing can take it from the target, because the target no longer has it.
tiers.card: It hands you one fact to hold — it can't be taken from someone who isn't carrying it

tiers.text: The target's name, face and nature can't be learned by magic at all, and anyone who tries learns something plausible and wrong instead.
tiers.card: Magic learns a plausible lie about it, never the truth

tiers.text: Unknown. For the hour the target does not appear in any record, memory, prophecy or divination — it may walk into anywhere it has a right to be, and afterwards, nobody is quite sure who was there.
tiers.card: UNKNOWN — 1 hr outside every record, memory and prophecy · afterwards nobody is sure who it was

utility.name: The Confidence
utility.description: Everyone tells somebody. You are usually the somebody.

tiers.text: Know whether a creature you can see is keeping a secret, roughly how heavy it is, and how long it has carried it.
tiers.card: Know who is keeping something, how heavy, and how long

tiers.text: Hide a thing, a message or a door so completely that only those you name can find it — no search, spell or accident reveals it for a month.
tiers.card: Hide a thing, message or door for a month — only your named can find it

tiers.text: Learn one secret a creature is keeping, if you can name the person it was kept from. It will not know how you know, but it will know that you do.
tiers.card: Learn one of their secrets — name who it was kept from

tiers.text: Trade: offer a secret of equal weight to any creature capable of understanding the exchange, and it is bound to answer in kind — truthfully, once, about anything you ask.
tiers.card: Trade a secret of equal weight — they must answer truthfully, once, about anything

creation.name: The Cache
creation.description: Things you make are not found until you want them found.

tiers.text: Your creations are unremarkable: they can't be perceived by anyone you have not named unless they are being used, and searches simply pass over them.
tiers.card: Creations go unseen by anyone you haven't named

tiers.text: Your Objects may hold a thing far larger than themselves, and only open for a name, a phrase or a person you choose.
tiers.card: Objects hold more than they should, and open only for the named

tiers.text: Your Structures have hidden ways: a door, a room or a passage nobody can find, map, or remember having seen.
tiers.card: Structures carry a way nobody can find, map or remember

tiers.text: Build a Vault: a permanent Structure that does not appear on any map, in any memory or in any divination, and whose contents cannot be located while it stands.
tiers.card: A VAULT — on no map, in no memory, in no divination, for as long as it stands

complementEffects.name: Told
complementEffects.description: The seal whispers something on the way in.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus psychic damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6) and can't speak until the end of its next turn.
effect.card: +1 die psychic · they can't speak until their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Two dice, and it can't cast spells with verbal components while silenced.
Level 11+: Three dice, and you learn one thing it is concealing.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · you learn one thing it hides

complementEffects.name: Unseen
complementEffects.description: The seal takes its targets off the record for a while.

effect.text: Each of the seal's targets can't be found by divination or scrying, and its thoughts can't be read, until the end of your next turn.
effect.card: The seal's targets: no scrying, no divination, no mind-reading

upgrades.text: Level 5+: It lasts 1 hour, and they leave no tracks or traces while it does.
Level 11+: Anyone trying to learn about them magically gets a plausible falsehood instead.
upgrades.card: Magic returns a plausible lie about them

complementEffects.name: Hushed
complementEffects.description: Where the seal landed, nothing carries.

effect.text: For 1 minute, nothing within 20 feet of the point of impact can be heard from outside it, and creatures that failed the seal's save can't call for help by any means.
effect.card: 20 ft of silence outward, 1 min · those who failed can't call for help

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Divination and scrying can't reach inside it either.
Level 11+: Creatures that failed can't later speak of what happened there.
